channel.title: Public Preview on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Public Preview on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Copilot harness support in Foundry Toolkit for VS Code
item.description:
Agent Builder in Microsoft Foundry Toolkit for VS Code now supports prompt agents using the Microsoft Copilot harness in public preview. Developers can configure tools and skills, edit local YAML definitions, deploy changes to Foundry, and run the agents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Programmed Training in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Programmed Training is now in public preview in Microsoft Foundry. It provides an API for building custom post-training loops over open-weight models, with access available by request through a preview sign-up form.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Multi-turn evaluation in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry now offers multi-turn evaluation in public preview. It lets you assess full agent conversations against quality standards instead of evaluating only individual responses.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Firewall for Containers
item.description:
Azure Firewall for Containers is in public preview. It extends Azure Firewall protections to containerized workloads so network traffic for container environments can be secured and managed centrally.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Improvements on the pull request overview in public preview
item.description:
GitHub updated the pull request Overview page in public preview with clearer merge status and more explicit next steps. The changes are based on feedback since the November 5, 2026 preview release.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: PostgreSQL 19 on Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server now supports PostgreSQL 19 in public preview in the East Asia region. You can provision new PostgreSQL 19 servers via the Azure portal and Azure CLI.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Zone resilience for Azure VMs
item.description:
Zone resilience for Azure VMs is in public preview. It allows an eligible zonal VM to be recovered in another availability zone within the same region while keeping the existing VM resource and configuration, with ZRS managed disks used for synchronous cross-zone replication.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Database Agent for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Public preview of Database Agent for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The feature monitors database health proactively and helps detect, understand, and respond to performance and health issues faster.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Connect Supabase, Box, Calendly, and more to Copilot
item.description:
GitHub added public preview support for connecting eight additional services to Copilot through GitHub-verified MCP servers (connectors). These join the more than 25 services already available.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI bot ruleset for Azure Front Door Premium WAF
item.description:
Azure Front Door Premium WAF now has a public preview AI bot ruleset. It lets you control access for AI crawlers and agents, complementing robots.txt for finer-grained traffic handling.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI-powered application and database modernization with Modernize CLI
item.description:
Modernize CLI is in public preview for AI-assisted application and database modernization. It assesses application architecture, dependencies, cloud readiness, and the databases an application uses to guide modernization as a connected workflow.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Immutable snapshots for Azure Disk Storage
item.description:
Immutable snapshots for Azure Disk Storage are now in public preview. They complement Azure Backup immutable vaults by providing a short-term backup option with faster recovery characteristics.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Pod Sandboxing kata-vm-isolation-v2 runtime class
item.description:
Azure announced a public preview of the kata-vm-isolation-v2 runtime class for pod sandboxing. It is intended to improve isolated pod startup performance and reduce memory overhead compared with classic sandboxed pod flows that boot a new Kata VM per pod.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Pulic Preview: Azure Elastic SAN Next Generation
item.description:
Azure Elastic SAN Next Generation is now in public preview. It retains the existing Elastic SAN model, including a single SAN resource hierarchy for consolidating block storage workloads and dynamically sharing performance.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Database Agent for SQL with contextual Copilot
item.description:
Database Agent for SQL is now in public preview with contextual Copilot-generated recommendations for detected database issues. The recommendations are grounded in available issue evidence and explain why the issue matters, the likely cause, and the next step.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL DB Hyperscale Cross Database Querying
item.description:
Azure SQL Database Hyperscale now supports native cross-database querying in public preview. Applications can access and join data across databases in the same Hyperscale elastic pool on a logical server using three-part T-SQL names.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Confidential VMs with OS Disk Encryption support on AKS
item.description:
Azure AKS confidential VM node pools now support OS disk encryption in public preview. This closes the at-rest gap for regulated customers by adding platform support for encrypting the OS disk on Ubuntu 26.04 confidential VM node pools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Service tags for inbound rules in network security perimeter
item.description:
Azure announced public preview support for using service tags as inbound rules for third-party customers in network security perimeter. The feature is meant to simplify access management for network security perimeter-protected resources.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Perimeter link (cross perimeter) in network security perimeter
item.description:
Public preview adds perimeter links for secure cross-perimeter connectivity between resources protected by different network security perimeters, while preserving perimeter-based access controls.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent Grid helping secure AI agent communications
item.description:
Agent Grid is now in public preview for supported Azure environments. It adds identity-based Zero Trust network security so security teams can centrally govern communication between agents, models, tools, and external services.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Adaptive Virtual Patching
item.description:
Azure Adaptive Virtual Patching is in public preview. It uses an AI-orchestrated Adaptive Shield to reduce exposure to new, emerging, and newly disclosed zero-day vulnerabilities while customers test and deploy patches, starting with Linux workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI Security add-on for Azure Firewall Premium
item.description:
Azure Firewall Premium now has a public preview AI Security add-on. It adds five capabilities aimed at protecting AI applications, sensitive data, and malware/application defenses.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Bastion RDP and SSH vision
item.description:
Azure Bastion RDP and SSH vision is in public preview. It adds AI-assisted review for recorded privileged sessions, including session summaries and insights into noteworthy or risky activity.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent Sandbox cluster extension
item.description:
Azure is introducing a public preview of an Agent Sandbox cluster extension for Kubernetes. It provides isolated environments for AI agent sessions that run untrusted, model-generated code, reducing the need for teams to build their own sandbox lifecycle and related operational logic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure API Management Application
item.description:
Azure API Management Applications is now in public preview for all customers, with no sign-up required. The feature helps organize APIs around consuming applications and manage application-level relationships.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI-assisted data modeler and other updates in Azure Cosmos DB extension for VS Code
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB extension for VS Code now includes a public preview AI-assisted Data Modeler. It helps design data models earlier by analyzing document structure, query patterns, write distribution, expected scale, and data growth.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Advanced load balancing in Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
Advanced load balancing for Azure Application Gateway is now in public preview. It adds more control over traffic distribution across backends for different workload types, including AI applications and web traffic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol support in Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent adds public preview support for the open Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol. This lets SRE agents delegate tasks to other agents and receive tasks from them while preserving each team’s permissions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI Assisted Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Application Code Migration
item.description:
A preview plugin adds AI-assisted conversion of application code from Oracle to PostgreSQL. It can be used through GitHub Copilot CLI or Visual Studio Code to help applications work with Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure App Service Builder
item.description:
Azure App Service Builder is in public preview. It provides a source-connected platform intended to simplify turning application code into a running cloud app by reducing the need to set up build pipelines, deployment workflows, and hosting infrastructure manually.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Application Gateway advanced routing rules
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway advanced routing rules is in public preview. It adds condition-based routing using HTTP request attributes, extending routing beyond traditional path- and host-based rules.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Application Gateway confidential compute support
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway confidential compute is now in public preview. It runs the Application Gateway data plane in a confidential computing environment to help protect sensitive data while requests are being processed, including after decryption.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Artifact Validation for VM images
item.description:
Azure Artifact Validation is now in public preview. It lets VM image publishers and enterprise platform teams run Azure certification-grade quality and security checks on images within their own Azure subscriptions at any point in the build process.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Blob Storage turbo tier
item.description:
Azure Blob Storage turbo tier is in Public Preview, adding SSD-backed performance for eligible Blob Storage accounts. It is intended for performance-sensitive workloads such as AI training, inference, and analytics.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Compute Spot plus
item.description:
Azure Compute Spot plus is now in public preview as an enhanced Azure Spot Virtual Machines tier. It is intended for interruption-tolerant workloads and offers greater runtime consistency plus earlier eviction signals.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Database for MySQL on Premium SSD v2
item.description:
Azure Database for MySQL now supports Premium SSD v2 managed disks in public preview. The update adds higher performance and better price-performance, with the ability to scale storage capacity independently.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure DDoS Protection peacetime telemetry
item.description:
Azure DDoS Protection peacetime telemetry is now in public preview. It lets customers view traffic to protected public IP addresses during normal operation, not just during active DDoS mitigation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure DDoS Protection support for NAT Gateway v2 IP
item.description:
Azure DDoS Protection now supports the public IPs used by Azure NAT Gateway StandardV2 in public preview. This extends network-layer DDoS protection to IPv4 and IPv6 addresses carrying outbound internet traffic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Files NFS shares on HDD
item.description:
Azure Files now supports NFS shares on HDD in public preview. This adds a lower-cost, fully managed option alongside the existing SSD-based NFS offering for Linux workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Functions Network Troubleshooter v2
item.description:
Azure Functions Network Troubleshooter v2 is now in public preview. It provides a top-down view of Function App dependencies across Storage, Service Bus, and Azure Files, with inspection details for supported dependencies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Functions support for Node.js 26
item.description:
Azure Functions now supports Node.js 26 in public preview. Developers can test JavaScript and TypeScript function apps on the new runtime while continuing to use the Azure Functions programming model on Linux in Flex Consumption and Elastic Premium plans.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Functions support for Python 3.15
item.description:
Azure Functions now has public preview support for Python 3.15. Developers can test Python apps, dependencies, native extensions, and deployment workflows with the existing v1 and v2 programming models.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Managed Redis agent kit
item.description:
Azure Managed Redis agent kit is now in public preview. It adds Redis-specific guidance for building and operating production-ready Redis applications directly into AI-assisted development workflows.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – AI summary of connection troubleshoot results
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher now has a public preview feature that uses AI to summarize connection troubleshoot results. It is intended to make the output of the four diagnostic connectivity tests easier and faster to understand.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Auto-create connection monitor
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher adds a public preview of auto-create connection monitor, which speeds up network monitoring setup across an Azure subscription. It replaces per-connection test creation with a subscription-wide creation flow.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Connection analyzer
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher’s Connection analyzer for ExpressRoute Circuit is in public preview. It helps pinpoint where packet loss occurs between Azure and on-premises by providing faster, evidence-based troubleshooting.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Packet capture insights
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher packet capture insights is in public preview. It uses AI-assisted analysis to surface findings from packet captures and can ingest structured protocol logs into Log Analytics for deeper investigation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Resource health and topology in connection monitor tests
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher connection monitor tests now include resource health metrics and key performance metrics in the test topology, powered by Network Watcher topology. This extends the topology view beyond just the path between source and destination.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL Database container provisioning in SQL Server Management Studio
item.description:
Azure SQL Database container provisioning is now in public preview in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS). You can create a development environment in seconds without needing an Azure subscription, credit card, or existing database.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Bring-your-own image and Cosmos DB MCP server in Azure Connector Namespace hosted MCP​
item.description:
Azure Connector Namespace now offers a public preview of hosted MCP server capability, letting AI agents use tools without developers managing a separate hosting stack. The preview also adds support for bring-your-own image and a Cosmos DB MCP server.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Build Knowledge Graphs with AI pipeline in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now offers a public preview of an AI pipeline that builds knowledge graphs from PostgreSQL data. The feature uses AI to extract entities, relationships, and properties from source data and construct a queryable graph.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Build with Azure SQL Database container locally without an Azure subscription or credit card
item.description:
Azure SQL Database container is now in public preview for local development and CI. It lets you build and test against the same engine used in Azure SQL Database without needing an Azure subscription or credit card.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Centralized user authentication + JWT validation for Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway now offers public preview for centralized user authentication using OpenID Connect, so sign-in can happen before traffic reaches the backend. The preview also includes an updated JWT validation experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Decision actions in Azure Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Decision actions are in public preview for Azure Logic Apps Automation. They let developers automate business decisions with AI without deploying or managing models.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: DocumentDB enabled by Azure Arc
item.description:
Azure Arc public preview now supports DocumentDB deployment on supported Arc-enabled Kubernetes clusters across on-premises, edge, and multicloud environments. It is intended for running MongoDB-compatible document workloads closer to applications.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: DocumentDB on Azure Local
item.description:
Azure Local now has a public preview of DocumentDB, enabling MongoDB-compatible document workloads to run on customer-managed infrastructure. This is intended for scenarios where applications and data need to stay close together for latency or data-location requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Durable Task SDK for Go
item.description:
The Durable Task SDK for Go is now in public preview. It lets developers write orchestrations, activities, and durable entities in Go, with Durable Task Scheduler handling execution history and work dispatch.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Embedding generation in Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB now offers public preview of built-in embedding generation. The feature converts content into vector embeddings using Azure Data-developed models to support semantic search and retrieval.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Encryption at rest with customer-managed keys in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now supports customer-managed keys (CMK) for encryption at rest in public preview. The service previously used only service-managed keys (SMK) by default.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Enhanced developer experience in Azure Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Azure Logic Apps Automation is in public preview with updated developer experiences for building, managing, and scaling business process automation. The preview includes a refreshed workflow designer and reusable templates, along with faster environment and application setup.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Fine-grained role-based access control for databases and collections in Azure DocumentDB
item.description:
Azure DocumentDB public preview adds fine-grained RBAC for databases and collections. It expands beyond cluster-level permissions to let you manage access at the database and collection level.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Full-text search in Azure DocumentDB
item.description:
Azure DocumentDB now supports full-text search in public preview. The preview includes BM25 indexing, relevance-based sorting, relevance scores, fuzzy search, and proximity search.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Geo-redundancy on Azure App Service
item.description:
Azure App Service geo-redundancy is now in public preview. It lets customers build more resilient web apps across Azure regions without having to separately create and manage an App Service deployment in each region.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Hosted Skill and Agent Bindings for Azure Functions
item.description:
Hosted Skill and Agent bindings for Azure Functions are in public preview. The bindings aim to reduce application plumbing and lifecycle code needed when adding agents, so developers can focus on business logic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: IP filtering in Azure Managed Redis
item.description:
Azure Managed Redis now supports firewall rules for data access in public preview. You can restrict cache connections by approved source IP addresses or Azure service tags.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Managed AI Models in Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Managed AI Models are in public preview for Azure Logic Apps Automation. They let developers add AI capabilities to workflows and agents without provisioning, deploying, or managing model infrastructure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Managed MCP Server in Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB now has a public preview of a managed, hosted MCP server for connecting enterprise AI agents to business data through a standard MCP endpoint. The preview supports schema discovery, document retrieval, and full-text/vector search.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Agent 365 for Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent now supports Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Microsoft Agent 365 in public preview. This lets security and IT teams view and govern SRE agents alongside other organizational agents, with each agent able to have its own Agent ID.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Teams integration for Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent now supports Microsoft Teams integration in public preview. Engineers can start investigations and interact with the agent in Teams chats, channels, and meeting chats without leaving the app.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate Oracle databases to Azure Database for PostgreSQL using Azure Database Migration Service
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service now supports offline migrations from Oracle to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The preview lets you configure source and target connections, choose schemas, start the transfer, and monitor migration status.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate Oracle databases to Azure HorizonDB using Azure Database Migration Service
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service now supports migrating Oracle databases to Azure HorizonDB in public preview. The migration flow covers source and target connection setup, schema selection, data transfer, and progress tracking in one experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code - local-to-cloud deployment wizard
item.description:
The MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code now includes a public preview wizard for deploying from a local Azure SQL Database container to Azure SQL Database. It supports schema-only or schema-and-data deployment.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code performance dashboard
item.description:
The MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code now has a public preview query performance dashboard. It uses Query Store to show performance insights, trend analysis, execution plans, and query optimization with GitHub Copilot.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code- Azure SQL Database container provisioning
item.description:
The MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code now supports Azure SQL Database container provisioning in public preview. It lets you create and manage a cloud-aligned local database environment, with automatic runtime detection across Docker, WSL, Apple containers, and Podman.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Native AWS and Google Cloud support in Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent now has built-in connectors for AWS and Google Cloud in public preview. This lets users investigate applications and dependencies across Azure and connected cloud environments from one place.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Native disaster recovery for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
item.description:
Azure Functions durable task scheduler now has public preview disaster recovery for the Dedicated SKU in supported Azure regions. It lets you recover workflow orchestration state after a regional outage without rebuilding it.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Network Watcher rule recommendation
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher rule recommendation is in public preview. It uses Traffic Analytics insights to identify network traffic patterns and suggest security rule improvements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Network Watcher VNet Flow Logs enriched with networkInterfaceIP field
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher VNet Flow Logs now include a new networkInterfaceIP field in public preview. The field records the IP address or addresses of the network interface where a flow was captured.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: New built-in Azure automation connectors in Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Azure Logic Apps Automation now has new built-in Azure automation connectors in public preview. The connectors support workflow automation across GitHub, Azure DevOps, and Azure management services.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Next-generation elastic architecture for Azure Application Gateway v2
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway v2 has a public preview of a next-generation elastic architecture. Microsoft says it can cut provisioning time by up to 50% and autoscaling time by up to 70% for demanding, dynamic workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Pod snapshot cluster extension
item.description:
Azure has a public preview for a pod snapshot cluster extension that helps sandboxed workloads avoid losing in-memory state on restart. It is aimed at reducing reload and warmup costs for AI environments and other applications.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Redis 8 in Azure Managed Redis
item.description:
Redis 8 is in public preview for Azure Managed Redis. The update adds richer queries, atomic JSON updates, field-level expiration, and finer-grained security.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Session-based authentication for Azure Blob and Data Lake Storage
item.description:
Session-based authentication is now in public preview for Azure Blob and Data Lake Storage. It is intended to reduce per-request authentication and authorization time for AI agents and applications while maintaining existing security controls.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Shard-level metrics in Azure Managed Redis
item.description:
Azure Managed Redis public preview now includes shard-level metrics. The new per-shard visibility helps assess workload distribution, detect hotspots, and troubleshoot performance issues.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Sovereign Control Panel
item.description:
Sovereign Control Panel is in public preview in Azure. It provides an Azure portal experience for assessing and continuously monitoring sovereignty posture and reviewing evidence behind identified gaps.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL Server 2025 support on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS
item.description:
SQL Server 2025 is now in public preview on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. This lets users evaluate, test, and deploy SQL Server on Canonical’s latest long-term supported platform.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Task Queues for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
item.description:
Task Queues for Azure Functions durable task scheduler are in public preview. They let workloads sharing a task hub use named queues so you can separate throughput needs and downstream service limits.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Virtual network integration in Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Virtual network (VNet) integration is now in public preview for Azure Logic Apps Automation. This lets workflows and agents connect securely to resources inside Azure virtual networks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: VM adaptive placement
item.description:
Azure VM adaptive placement is in public preview. It can improve VM deployment success when capacity is constrained by allowing Azure to place a VM on an available size instead of failing a create request for one exact size.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Windows Server 2028
item.description:
Windows Server 2028 is in public preview as the next LTSC release. The preview focuses on security, virtualization, hybrid cloud management, and hybrid intelligence for mission-critical workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Windows Trusted Launch
item.description:
AKS is adding public preview support for Windows Trusted Launch for Windows node pools running Windows Server 2025. This provides stronger boot-chain protection for Windows workloads in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Discover Data Guardian from Sovereign Control Panel
item.description:
Data Guardian is now discoverable from the Sovereign Control Panel and is in Public Preview. It provides oversight for qualifying Microsoft engineer remote access to in-scope production systems in the EU data boundary.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate Azure Database for PostgreSQL to Azure HorizonDB with Azure Database Migration Service (DMS)
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service (DMS) now supports migrating existing Azure Database for PostgreSQL workloads to Azure HorizonDB in public preview. The update extends DMS V2 architecture with HorizonDB as a migration target.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate PostgreSQL servers to Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service now supports public preview migrations of supported PostgreSQL workloads to Azure HorizonDB. The migration experience is guided and available in the Azure portal.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot CLI adds Microsoft Entra sign-in as a preview
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI now supports Microsoft Entra authentication in public preview. Users can sign in with a Microsoft Entra account to authenticate to a linked GitHub Enterprise Managed User.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot Evals is now in public preview
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Evals is now available in public preview. It lets you evaluate and tune Copilot usage as prompts, models, skills, and tools change.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Manage AI Scan for repositories using the REST API
item.description:
GitHub added a public preview REST API for enabling or disabling code scanning’s AI Scan at both the organization and repository levels. The feature introduces a new repository_scan setting.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: JWT validation with Azure Front Door Auth Policy
item.description:
Azure Front Door Premium now supports JWT validation in public preview through the Front Door Auth Policy. It validates Microsoft Entra ID bearer tokens at the edge before traffic reaches APIs or web applications.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Auto scaling of ingestion limits in Azure Monitor workspace
item.description:
Azure Monitor Workspace now has a public preview feature for auto scaling ingestion limits per workspace. When enabled, the service adjusts the quota ceiling automatically based on observed usage patterns to help maintain healthy ingestion.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL performance monitoring for Azure SQL Managed Instance
item.description:
Microsoft has released a public preview of Microsoft-managed performance monitoring for Azure SQL Managed Instance. It is intended to replace custom scripts and disconnected tools for monitoring business-critical workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Rate limit grouping for Azure Front Door Premium WAF
item.description:
Azure Front Door Premium WAF now supports rate limit grouping in public preview. This lets rate limit rules aggregate requests across a group instead of counting only per client IP, which helps with distributed attacks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Distributed accelerator for cloud storage on AKS
item.description:
Distributed accelerator for cloud storage (DACS) is now in public preview for AI workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). It runs as a distributed read-through cache within the cluster and uses local NVMe disks across nodes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Front Door adds native gRPC support
item.description:
Azure Front Door Standard and Premium now have public preview support for gRPC. The feature lets you route requests to specific services and methods and distribute traffic for gRPC applications through Front Door.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Public Preview: Azure Route Server dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 support
item.description:
Azure Route Server now supports IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack mode in public preview. It enables route exchange for both address families over supported hybrid networking connections, while existing IPv4 connections remain unchanged.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Modernize Arc-enabled Windows Servers with Azure File Sync
item.description:
Azure File Sync for Arc-enabled Windows Servers is now in preview. The update adds a guided Azure portal experience to help modernize servers and move or sync data with Azure Files while keeping the local file server model.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Secret scanning detects secrets in GitHub Actions workflow logs
item.description:
GitHub secret scanning now detects secrets in GitHub Actions workflow logs. The feature is available in public preview and adds workflow logs to the existing scanning coverage for issues, wikis, discussions, and pull requests.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: New pull request overview page in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has introduced a new pull request overview page in public preview. It is intended to make it easier to see what is blocking a long pull request without scrolling through extensive comments and timeline events.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s coding assistant
item.description:
GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s built-in coding assistant as a public preview. The integration lets users access Copilot directly within the native Xcode workflow.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Firewall IPv6 now supports application rules
item.description:
Azure Firewall IPv6 is now in public preview for application rules, adding layer 7 filtering for IPv6 HTTP and HTTPS traffic. This extends application-level controls to IPv6 and dual-stack deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Multi-disk crash-consistent VM restore points for Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Disks on VMs with SCSI disk controller
item.description:
Azure VM public preview adds multi-disk crash-consistent restore points for Premium SSD v2 and Ultra data disks on VMs using SCSI disk controllers. It supports agent-less capture of crash-consistent restore points.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: JWT validation for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports centralized JWT validation in public preview through the AuthPolicy custom resource. It can validate token signature, issuer, lifetime, and configured audience using signing keys from a trusted HTTP source.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: MCP gateway for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) routing in preview via a new MCPRoute custom resource. This lets platform teams expose MCP servers behind a stable hostname and path while centralizing TLS and JWT validation through Web Application Firewall features.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Private ingress for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports private frontends in public preview. These frontends are reachable only through approved Azure Private Link private endpoints, keeping internal, shared, and cross-cluster traffic on private networking.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Advanced capacity insights are now available in Azure Storage Discovery
item.description:
Azure Storage Discovery is adding advanced capacity insights in public preview. The update expands visibility into storage usage with insights such as access patterns, data age, storage tiers, object size distribution, and retention-related data.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Extend immutability for PITR backups for Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance
item.description:
Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance now support extending immutability for PITR backups in public preview. This lets you lock backup retention to the configured PITR retention period instead of only the default 7 days.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: On-prem NAS share discovery and assessment are now available using Azure Migrate
item.description:
Azure Migrate added public preview support for discovering and assessing on-premises NAS shares. The feature helps plan migrations of Dell PowerScale (OneFS) and NetApp ONTAP storage to Azure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Support database-level managed identity (including FIC) in Create Database Scoped Credential T-SQL
item.description:
Azure SQL Database public preview adds database-level managed identity support, including federated identity credentials (FIC), for creating database scoped credentials in T-SQL. This lets each database use a user-assigned managed identity to access Azure Blob Storage and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 via external tables and OPENROWSET.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Cross Tenant Restore with Azure Backup
item.description:
Azure Backup now supports Cross-Tenant Restore in public preview, allowing Azure VM backups to be restored into a separate Azure tenant. This provides an independent recovery path using the existing backup copy, without needing custom backup infrastructure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Security extension for the GitHub Copilot app
item.description:
A new GitHub security extension is available in public preview for the GitHub Copilot app. It lets you review and work through repository code scanning alerts without leaving the app.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot supports server-to-server authentication
item.description:
GitHub Copilot now supports server-to-server authentication for GitHub Apps installed on organizations, in public preview. This lets services and agents built with the GitHub Copilot SDK make authenticated requests on behalf of an app without user-based auth.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Public monitoring now available with data residency
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency now supports public monitoring in public preview. This extends secret scanning beyond internal repositories to monitor public content.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub CLI: Opt in to expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens
item.description:
GitHub CLI now offers a public preview of expiring OAuth credentials that automatically refresh. When enabled, gh stores an expiring access token and uses refresh flow to keep it valid.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Disable VNet peering route
item.description:
Azure announced public preview of Disable VNet Peering Route (DPR), a route-table capability that suppresses system-generated peering routes on subnets associated with the route table. This gives more control over traffic flow between peered virtual networks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub package firewall in public preview
item.description:
GitHub package firewall is now in public preview. It is intended to reduce malware risks during package installation by blocking package-install-time attacks that can steal credentials from CI/CD hosts or developer workstations.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Databricks Private network gateway
item.description:
Azure Databricks Private network gateway is now in Public Preview. It lets serverless compute reach resources in your VNet and transitively connected networks through a single managed gateway.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Files cross-region data copy and synchronization with Azure Storage Mover
item.description:
Azure Files now supports copying and synchronizing file share data across storage accounts, Azure regions, and subscriptions within the same tenant using Azure Storage Mover. The feature is in public preview and supports scheduled incremental transfers to maintain secondary copies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles in public preview
item.description:
GitHub Actions workflow dependency lockfiles are now in public preview for GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency, Team, and Free plans. They let workflows pin dependencies more reliably even if tags or branches later move.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Push attribution for commits in limited public preview
item.description:
GitHub now records the authenticated user who pushed each commit and exposes that pusher identity in the UI and API. This is in limited public preview and is available alongside the existing author and committer fields.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management
item.description:
Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management is now in public preview. The integration connects centralized governance with runtime enforcement for MCP servers and tools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AKS on bare metal now on Ubuntu
item.description:
Azure has a public preview for running AKS on bare metal using Ubuntu, aimed at on-premises Kubernetes deployments without a virtualization layer. The update highlights support for local control of hardware and software, with a focus on AI workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure HorizonDB expands to additional regions
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is now available in additional Azure regions in public preview. The expansion gives users more deployment options for PostgreSQL workloads closer to applications and users.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: IPv6 Support for Application Gateway WAF
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway WAF now supports inspection and enforcement for IPv6 traffic in Public Preview. This adds IPv6 support to the web application firewall layer.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Major version upgrades (MVU) for Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters now support major version upgrades in public preview. Existing clusters can be upgraded in place to a newer supported PostgreSQL version without creating a replacement cluster or migrating distributed data.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Repository security advisory comments API in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has added REST API support for reading, adding, and editing comments on repository security advisories. The API also works for advisories created from private vulnerability reports.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot can now interact with desktop apps with computer use
item.description:
GitHub Copilot computer use is now in public preview in Copilot CLI and the Copilot app on macOS and Windows. It can interact with desktop applications on the user’s behalf.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL performance monitoring for SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines
item.description:
Microsoft has released a public preview of Microsoft-managed performance monitoring for SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines. It lets you monitor SQL Server on Azure VMs without creating custom collection scripts or manually correlating telemetry.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Ubuntu 26.04 support in AKS
item.description:
AKS now has public preview support for Ubuntu 26.04 node pools through a new Ubuntu2604 OS SKU based on Ubuntu Minimal. The update is intended to help teams move with Ubuntu LTS releases while addressing package footprint, security, and compatibility concerns.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Automatic Zone Placement for Virtual Machine Scale Sets
item.description:
Azure has introduced a public preview of Automatic Zone Placement for Virtual Machine Scale Sets. Azure will automatically choose suitable availability zones based on SKU availability, capacity, and placement requirements, reducing the need to manage zone lists manually.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Ultra Disk
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server now supports Ultra Disk in public preview. It is intended for I/O-intensive, transaction-heavy workloads that need consistently low latency.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL Performance Monitoring for Azure SQL Database
item.description:
Microsoft has opened public preview of managed SQL performance monitoring for Azure SQL Database. It provides built-in monitoring so you do not need custom data collection scripts or manual correlation across separate tools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public preview: Script-based deployment for SQL Server on Linux Azure VM
item.description:
Public preview of a script-based deployment flow for SQL Server on Linux Azure VMs. It replaces legacy marketplace images with automated provisioning and adds more flexibility and customization.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for late-September 2026
item.description:
Late-September 2026 Azure SQL preview updates include Database Hub in Microsoft Fabric. The hub provides a unified experience for discovering, managing, monitoring, and optimizing databases across SQL Server and Azure SQL.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL Database Hyperscale Serverless auto-pause and auto-resume
item.description:
Azure SQL Database Hyperscale Serverless now supports auto-pause and auto-resume in public preview. Databases can pause during inactivity and resume automatically when activity returns.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate directly from Azure Arc to Azure SQL Database, including Hyperscale
item.description:
Azure Arc database migration now supports Azure SQL Database, including Hyperscale, as a direct migration target in public preview. The guided workflow also handles Azure Database Migration Service and Self-hosted Integration Runtime setup.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft SQL Agent Skills
item.description:
Microsoft SQL Agent Skills are in public preview. They provide product-specific guidance for AI agents used to build, operate, and migrate SQL workloads across Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Database container, and SQL Server migration scenarios.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Long-term retention (LTR) v2 for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
LTR v2 for Azure Database for PostgreSQL is in public preview. It replaces LTR v1’s logical pg_dump/pg_restore backups with physical snapshot-based backups integrated with Azure Backup Vaults.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview : Microsoft entra kerberos authentication for Azure NetApp Files
item.description:
Azure NetApp Files now supports Microsoft Entra Kerberos authentication for SMB volumes in public preview. It allows hybrid and cloud-only users to authenticate via Microsoft Entra ID using cloud-issued Kerberos tickets.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL Dev Hub
item.description:
Azure SQL Dev Hub is in public preview as a central starting point for building applications with Azure SQL. It provides guidance for connecting from .NET, Python, Node.js, and Java, and supports development workflows including AI agents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure HorizonDB supports PostgreSQL 18
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is now in public preview with PostgreSQL 18 support. The service is a fully managed, PostgreSQL-compatible cloud-native database for scalable, high-performance workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Flex Nodes for AKS
item.description:
Flex Nodes for AKS is now in public preview. It lets application and platform teams use hybrid and edge infrastructure as connected worker nodes to an AKS control plane in Azure, while keeping a consistent Kubernetes control plane.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Foundry Routines in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Foundry Agent Service now includes Foundry Routines in public preview. This adds a native trigger primitive so published agents can run automatically on schedules or in response to business events.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Mdsv4 and Msv4 Series Virtual Machines for SAP
item.description:
Azure announced public preview availability of the Mdsv4 and Msv4 memory-optimized virtual machine series for SAP. The series uses 6th Generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors and includes advanced security features plus Azure Boost technologies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Network egress controls for hosted agents in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry public preview now supports network egress controls for hosted agents. Customers can define ordered outbound rules by destination host, including wildcard FQDNs like *.contoso.com, with allow or deny actions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Payments HSM v2
item.description:
Azure Payments HSM v2 is in public preview. It is a highly available, single-tenant payment HSM service for payment processing, credential issuance, PIN processing, key management, and authentication data protection, with exclusive administrative control retained by the customer.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for mid-September 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL added a public preview for soft delete on logical servers. When a logical server is deleted, it enters a soft-deleted state and can be restored within the configured window.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Red Hat OpenShift with hosted control planes
item.description:
Azure Red Hat OpenShift with hosted control planes is now in public preview. This deployment option separates the OpenShift control plane into a fully managed service from the worker nodes that run customer workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: PostgreSQL skills and MCP plugin for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Microsoft previewed PostgreSQL skills and an MCP plugin for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The plugin is intended to make supported AI coding assistants context-aware for PostgreSQL and able to provide guidance and perform actions on a connected database.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot suggests custom properties definitions
item.description:
GitHub Copilot can now suggest allowed values when creating custom properties for repositories in an organization. The feature is in public preview for GitHub Copilot Business and Copilot users.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: HTTP/3 over QUIC support in Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway now has public preview support for HTTP/3 over QUIC. The update is intended to improve connection setup time, reduce latency, and increase resiliency for web applications and APIs.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agentless migration of on-premises SMB file shares to Azure Files (SMB)
item.description:
Azure Storage Mover now supports agentless migration of on-premises SMB file shares to Azure Files (SMB) in public preview. The migration can move data from Windows Server or NAS shares without deploying, registering, or maintaining a migration agent.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Refreshed repository pull requests page in public preview
item.description:
GitHub is previewing a refreshed repository-level pull request listing page for all users. The update adds stronger filtering and a compact presentation mode.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: AI Scan for pull request APIs in public preview
item.description:
GitHub code scanning’s AI Scan for pull request feature can now be enabled and managed via REST API at both the organization and repository levels. The APIs are in public preview.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Xcode 27 runner image now runs on macOS 27
item.description:
GitHub’s Xcode 27 runner image for GitHub-hosted macOS runners now runs on macOS 27 and is available in public preview. This lets you validate Apple apps against macOS 27 using that runner image.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Front Door profile and route level WAF policies
item.description:
Azure Front Door Web Application Firewall (WAF) now supports associating WAF policies at the profile and route levels in public preview. This lets you apply baseline protection across a profile and more targeted policies on specific routes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Reader Endpoint for Azure Database for MySQL
item.description:
Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server now has a public preview of a reader endpoint to simplify connection management when using multiple replicas. The endpoint provides automatic load balancing for read-only connections.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Per-disk resiliency for Azure VMs
item.description:
Azure VMs now have a public preview option for per-disk resiliency. By default, Azure still recovers a VM by shutting it down and powering it back on after managed disk connectivity is restored.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: aks: AppNet 2026-08-19
item.description:
AppNet 2026-08-19 adds public preview availability in more Azure regions, retires AppNet 1.0–1.2, and updates supported versions to Istio 1.28.10, 1.29.6, and new AppNet 1.5 on Istio 1.30.3. The release also includes fixes for cluster validation, gateway CRD conflicts, certificate rotation, multicluster traffic, identity-based updates, cleanup on delete/leave, diagnostics, and clearer error reporting.

  • Source: Release notes from AKS

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: IPv6 dual-stack support for Azure Bastion
item.description:
Azure Bastion now supports IPv4 and IPv6 dual-stack configurations in public preview. New Bastion deployments can be configured with both IPv4 and IPv6 public IP addresses.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Introducing Live Reports for Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Live Reports are now in Public Preview for Azure SRE Agent. They let operations teams create dynamic operational views from SRE Agent conversations and keep them updated with the latest data.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Push rules in rulesets now support path exceptions
item.description:
Push rules in GitHub rulesets now support path exceptions, letting you exempt specific file paths so a rule applies everywhere else in scope. The feature is available in public preview.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: The new GitHub Copilot experience in Slack
item.description:
GitHub’s Slack integration now includes agentic GitHub Copilot capabilities from Copilot CLI and the Copilot app, available in public preview. Users can interact with @GitHub in Slack to work with these features.

  • Source: GitHub
